title: オリジナル妖怪の絵巻風イラスト
lead: 傘・提灯・古い道具などに宿る、オリジナルの妖怪12点です。和風の絵巻のタッチで描いています。イベントの告知や和風デザインに使えます。
subject_en: Japanese picture-scroll (emakimono) style, each ONE ORIGINAL yokai character invented for this series, centred, ink outlines with soft mineral-pigment colours of indigo, vermilion, ochre and moss green, friendly and slightly humorous, no existing yokai names or copyrighted characters. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: an old paper umbrella with one eye and one leg hopping
a paper lantern with a wide mouth and a long tongue
a round clay stove spirit with a smiling face and rising steam
a wooden clog with tiny arms and a face on its strap
a small mallet with legs and a lucky grin
a pot with a lid for a hat and peeking eyes
a calligraphy brush walking on its bristles with ink drops
a folding screen with a face peeking from the panels
a small fox-shaped flame spirit with a curling tail
an original river creature with a plate-like head and a round shell, holding a lotus leaf
an original snow spirit in a pale kimono-like robe with a swirling scarf
a cat spirit with two tails sitting on a roof tile
